user.title: Set up Xiaomi S400
user.description: Choose the scale and enter its existing local BLE credentials.

data_description.address: The six-byte Bluetooth address of the scale, as offered in the dropdown.

keys.title: Use existing local credentials
keys.description: The 16-byte bindkey enables passive advertisements. Add the 12-byte token to make Home Assistant connect when the scale wakes and receive automatic live and final measurements over GATT.

data_description.bindkey: Obtain this key from Xiaomi Cloud Tokens Extractor after pairing the scale. It decrypts the scale's advertisements.
data_description.token: Optional. Only needed for the active GATT stream. Leave empty for passive-only operation.

reconfigure.title: Update credentials
reconfigure.description: Replace the stored bindkey and/or token, for example after re-pairing the scale in the Xiaomi Home app.

data_description.bindkey: Obtain this key from Xiaomi Cloud Tokens Extractor after pairing the scale. It decrypts the scale's advertisements.
data_description.token: Optional. Only needed for the active GATT stream. Leave empty for passive-only operation.

discovery_confirm.title: Xiaomi S400 discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Enter this scale’s existing bindkey and optional GATT token. This step does not reset or provision the scale.

init.title: Scale behavior
init.description: Adjust repair sensitivity and active Bluetooth timing. Changes reload the integration.

data.failure_threshold: Failed measurement frames before a bindkey repair (1–20)
data.active_retry_interval: Minimum time between active connection attempts (seconds, 1–300)

error.invalid_key: Bindkey must be 32 hex characters and token, when supplied, 24 hex characters.
error.reload_failed: Credentials were saved, but the integration could not be reloaded. Check its logs and reload it manually.

abort.entry_not_found: The scale configuration no longer exists.

credentials.title: Update the Xiaomi S400 credentials
credentials.description: Repeated measurement advertisements failed authentication. Enter the current bindkey and optional token; if the scale was re-paired, obtain its new key first. Confirm the next measurement after the integration reloads.
